text:
maria_cs: FYI NorthBridge is asking to onboard an ensemble reranker + compact ranker combo. They want private deployment (VPC) and HSM for keys. Also asked for low-latency tail SLOs and a plan for safety/eval.

maria_cs: high-level asks from customer: keep phi off-host, quantized 8-bit model for cost, canary rollout w/ fallback to hosted 7b, eval suite for hallucination & biased outputs, renewal risk flagged if slow start.

tom_solutions: thanks — what's the expected qps and peak burst? that drives dedicated vs private sizing.

maria_cs: initial estimate 25 qps steady, 100 qps burst (checkout spikes). They expect 3k requests/day first month.

jay_runtime: 25 qps steady for an ensemble (reranker + small ranker) with KV warm cache is doable on 2x A100-equivalent in Dedicated. For Private (VPC) we'll need similar sizing or more depending on network egress.

sophia_prod: on the rollout side we should recommend: 1) small internal canary (1% traffic), 2) customer-specified canary (10% traffic) for 24h, 3) full roll. Add automatic fallback policy to hosted 7b if latency > 300ms p95.

oliver_security: HSM/KMS: customer wants HSM. We support KMS integrations in Private. Need legal sign-off for key custody + an onboarding ticket to get HSM certs. Also: data residency confirmation for PHI.

maria_cs: noted — I'll ping the customer for the module that handles PHI redaction. They said PHI will be pretokenized on their side but want proof-of-process.

tom_solutions: we should also capture a short eval plan to validate quality drop from quantization + ensemble fusion. propose: baseline gen/hallucination tests on 500 dev samples + pairwise reranker A/B on annotated set (n=2k).

jay_runtime: for quantized path we'll create a compatibility build: q8n rollout candidate + fallback to fp16. Add a warmup script to prefill KV cache: `python tools/warm_cache.py --host <ip> --paths /kv/prefixes.txt`.

maria_cs: can you add that warmup script to the onboarding checklist? I'll include an enablement session for their SRE.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist created: ONBOARD-4678. Assigned to tom_solutions, jay_runtime. Due: 1746590721.

oliver_security: one more: create a short audit log policy doc for the customer (what we log, retention, redaction). I'll draft a template and drop in /docs/onboarding-templates.

sophia_prod: renewal-risk note: since they expect low initial volume, add a 30/60/90 activation plan and quarterly usage review so Sales can decide on early upsell. Capture this in the renewal playbook.

maria_cs: next steps: I'll collect their eval dataset and PHI handling attestation, schedule a 60-min enablement call for Wed 10AM PT, and link ONBOARD-4678. tagging @tom_solutions @jay_runtime @oliver_security for any missing asks.

tom_solutions: good. I'll draft the sizing options and a dedicated fallback routing policy.

jay_runtime: I'll prepare the quantized candidate build and warmup script, and add a latency dashboard template to Console.

oliver_security: drafting audit & HSM checklist now, will share by EOD.

maria_cs: thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll post the customer dataset link and attestation once I get it, and update ONBOARD-4678.
